'''Shewski The Dark Gambler (DEAL)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Shewski]]
* '''Published:''' 2 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Deal Shewski DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck aims to get Dark Deal running quickly on Bespin and generally annoy your opponent through the Sabacc skills of Lando and a little alien named Trinto.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

I have just decided to get back into the game, after letting it gather dust when I left for college, four years ago.  (Jabba’s Palace just came out)  I started picking up cards on eBay this past summer.  I am going to start posting some decks and try to get feedback on where they can be tuned/tweaked/scrapped.  I have all cards up to SE, most of Tatooine and Theed Palace, a few from Endor, DS2, and none of EPP and Coruscant.

Thanks!

The main goal of this deck is to get Lando safely to the Casino and let him play cards.  I typically do this by pulling CC: Security Tower, Aurra Sing, and ZiMH with my starting interrupt. (Is it legal to pull ZiMH with it?)  With Secret Plans on the table, I can search through my reserve deck, usually without letting the opponent verify and find my third CC site to get DD up and running.  I would like to include DS Lobot, but I don't have him so Barquin is my gambler backup.  (I feel he has a stronger standalone game text compared to Watto-any other DS gamblers?)  The Dark Jedi Saber lets me use it on a variety of characters (it was that or Maul's single saber).  My favorite thing to do is play Sabacc during my battle phase- it drains the opponent's reserve deck and lets my Trinto's be even more damaging.  I'm thinking of putting in Bad Feeling Have I and His Name Is Anakin to make the opponent have a tendency to over-activate to make the Sabacc more painful.  Expand The Empire gives me some options regarding where to play Sabacc.  Other things I would like to add: Obsidian 8 and OS-71-2 in Ob. 2.  The other thing I am concerned about is the anti-Sabacc defensive shield.  Is there any way around that, or do I need to find a better retrieval strategy?

Let me know what you think!

EDIT:

Cam, I considered putting in I'm Sorry, but did not since I already have two CC locations from the start with Any Methods Necesary.  I don't have CC Occupation as of yet, but when I do get it I plan on incorporating it and I'm Sorry and scrapping the Sabacc retrieval, since holding Bespin should not be a problem.

Revelation, again, please read my strategy section.  I mention the the Sabacc Def Shield and am trying to see if you think it is viable at all with that card in play.
